name: visible-thinking-brief
description: Eliminate black-box tool spinners: instructs the agent to emit a crisp 1-2 sentence plain-prose brief before every tool batch explaining what was observed and why the next action is running, automatically matching the user's language.
suggestedPrompts: Audit the authentication flow in this repository and explain each inspection step briefly as you go
Trace why the integration tests are flaky and narrate each diagnostic command before running it
Compare the two candidate architectures and state what each file lookup is verifying
